freeze.note: Rows pin r2 because accept-d84/accept-o84 grade FROZENCFG by comparing the --freeze claims.json bytes to the lands bytes; r0/r1 freeze tokens would fail at an r2 lands. Counter code is byte-identical r0..r2.

census_commands: git show $B:SKILL.md | awk '/^## Gates and probes$/{f=1;next} /^## /{if(f)exit} f&&/^\|/{n++} END{print n-2}'
git show $B:SKILL.md | awk '/^## Gates and probes$/{f=1;next} /^## /{if(f)exit} f&&/^\|/{print; c++; if(c==2)exit}' | awk -F'|' '{print NF-2}'
comm -23 <(git ls-tree -r --name-only $B -- reports | grep -E '^reports/round-[^/]+/accept-[^/]+\.py$' | sort -u) <(cells | grep -oE 'reports/round-[^/]+/accept-[^/]+\.py' | sort -u) | wc -l
comm -23 <(cells | grep -oE '(tools|reports)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.py' | sort -u) <(git ls-tree -r --name-only $B | sort -u) | wc -l
comm -23 <(git ls-tree -r --name-only $B -- tools | grep -E '^tools/[^/]+\.py$' | sort -u) <(cells | grep -oE '(tools|reports)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.py' | sort -u) | wc -l
mkdir -p base-export && git archive $B | tar -x -C base-export && python3 base-export/tools/check-gate-registry.py --root base-export
